name: C1_planted_edge_control
hypothesis: CONTROL - identical pipeline with +40bp/trade (amended 2026-08-26a: must exceed measured ~26bp T2 round-trip) synthetically injected must PASS at T2; a fail means the harness cannot detect a deployable edge
power_argument: Random entries at ~10/day on 2 symbols over a 92-day validation window yield ~1800 trades; at per-trade vol of tens of bps, t>=2 under the null occurs ~2.3% of the time one-sided. A PASS is therefore strong evidence of harness defect, which is the point of this control.
